subject: Travel Itinerary Confirmation
body: Dear Mr. Johnson, We are pleased to confirm your upcoming travel itinerary for your business trip to New York City. Your flight is scheduled for Thursday, June 10th, departing at 8:00 AM from JFK Airport. Your hotel reservation at the Hilton Midtown has been successfully secured for two nights. Please find attached the detailed itinerary for your reference. Should you have any questions or require further assistance, feel free to contact our customer service team. We wish you a pleasant and successful trip.
